leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the draining spaces directly to the larger vessels was confusing: the physical connection seemed reasonable, but the route had to be prepared first.

surprise.text: Inspecting the completed return route automatically joined it to the draining spaces after my earlier direct attempt had failed.

arbitrary.text: The need to connect the larger vessels to the vein before joining them to the draining spaces felt like an unexplained prerequisite.
